jobs.title: Forward Deployed Solution Engineer – Applied AI FDE
jobs.jd: Team Bio: ServiceNow’s Applied AI Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team is where bold ideas meet transformative action. We partner with our most strategic customers to shape the future of enterprise AI. Together, we identify high-value opportunities, accelerate business outcomes, and build reusable AI-native solutions that advance the Now AI Platform. Our mission: We partner deeply with our customers to build intelligent, scalable AI solutions that solve their most mission-critical challenges. By embedding in real-world complexity, we deliver fast, iterate with purpose, and transform every success into reusable patterns that accelerate transformation across the Now Platform and the broader enterprise. Why This Role Matters: Enterprises are raising the bar. AI initiatives must deliver business value—not just promise potential. That means taking cutting-edge LLM capabilities and turning them into resilient, secure, and scalable software. As a Forward Deployed Software Engineer (FDSE) , you act as the CTO of the build—owning everything from backend services to LLM pipelines and front-end integrations. You partner with customers in the field to design, implement, and deliver solution-ready builds in agile sprints. Your software becomes the reference implementation for scalable GenAI in the enterprise. You codify patterns, shape internal tooling, and accelerate innovation—delivering systems that are battle-tested in production and scalable across industries. Who You Are: You are a systems-minded, AI-native engineer who ships real software. You own the full stack—and are equally motivated by elegant APIs, intuitive UIs, and scalable orchestration pipelines. You think like a product-minded CTO, balancing creativity with pragmatism to deliver impact. What You’ll Do: As a GenAI/ML Engineer on the FDE team, you will: Forward Deployed Engineers sit alongside our customers and turn ambiguous business problems into working AI systems. Partner directly with customers to discover problems and frame high-impact AI use cases. Design and build end-to-end GenAI/ML systems — RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, evaluation, and guardrails — and ship them to production. Prototype quickly, iterate with real users, and harden pilots into reliable, monitored services. Own the technical relationship, translating between business stakeholders and engineering. Raise the bar for ML depth and engineering quality across the team. What Success Looks Like: Production-grade delivery: Your solution builds consistently convert to scaled deployments in production environments Reusable impact: You author libraries, prompts, and scaffolds that power multiple deployments and projects Platform influence: Your work shapes internal tooling and is integrated into platform roadmap and primitives Velocity and precision: You move fast without breaking things—shaping resilient, secure systems in high-stakes contexts Engineering leadership: You are trusted by architects, PMs, and customer teams to lead implementation from zero to one What You Bring: Experience: In leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry Relevant Experience: 8+ years of software engineering, including 2+ years building systems in customer-facing or embedded roles. Experience building machine learning/ GenAI systems with modern AI/ML technologies, including LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, and RAG architectures. System architecture: Proven ability to design and implement AI-native software in production environments Engineering depth: Strength in backend (Python, Node.js, Java), frontend (React, Angular), APIs (REST/GraphQL) LLM tooling: Familiarity with LangChain, Semantic Kernel, prompt chaining, vector search, and context management Performance & observability: Skilled in debugging distributed systems, tuning for latency, and implementing monitoring Platform mindset: Can contribute to shared SDKs and tools, raising engineering velocity for the whole org Product sensibility: Prioritize for user value, MVP iteration, and long-term scale DevOps fluency: Experience deploying in AWS, Azure, or GCP with CI/CD, containers, and infra-as-code Field readiness: Able to travel up to 30% to embed onsite and deliver where it matters Preferred Qualifications: Experience integrating AI into SaaS platforms like ServiceNow or Salesforce Track record of production deployments in secure, regulated enterprise environments Contributions to dev experience tooling, frameworks, or reusable AI scaffolds Work Personas We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer  (vLLM)
jobs.jd: *Telecommuting permitted: work may be performed within normal commuting distance from the Red Hat, LLC office in Boston, MA. Lead the design and implementation of high-performance Python, C++, CUDA, and Triton code for vLLM-based inference systems, GPU kernels, and numerical computing components in production-scale LLM serving environments. What You Will Do: Architect, develop, and optimize advanced LLM inference algorithms, including quantization, sparsification, speculative decoding, paged attention, KV cache optimization, batching, scheduling, and memory management, to significantly improve latency, throughput, scalability, and cost efficiency. Drive deep performance profiling, benchmarking, and modeling on NVIDIA GPUs, using tools such as Nsight Systems, Nsight Compute, CUPTI, PyTorch Profiler, CUDA, Triton, and CUTLASS to identify bottlenecks and deliver measurable system-level improvements. Own the end-to-end optimization of vLLM-based inference pipelines, including kernel-level tuning, runtime optimization, distributed inference, multi-GPU serving, tensor/pipeline parallelism, and large-scale deployment performance. Evaluate, prototype, and integrate state-of-the-art LLM serving techniques from cutting-edge research and open-source communities, including quantization, sparsity, speculative decoding, continuous batching, prefix caching, attention optimization, and model compression. Set engineering standards for performance-critical code, conduct rigorous peer reviews, guide testing and benchmarking strategies, and leverage AI-assisted development tools to maintain high code quality, reliability, and maintainability. Contribute to and maintain upstream open-source ML infrastructure vLLM, including reviewing pull requests, triaging issues, participating in design discussions, and supporting release readiness. Stay at the forefront of LLM systems research and GPU computing advancements, proactively identifying opportunities to improve the product through emerging techniques in serving efficiency, hardware utilization, and model acceleration. What You Will Bring: Master's degree (U.S. or foreign equivalent) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field and three (3) years of experience in the job offered or related role OR Bachelor's degree (U.S. or foreign equivalent) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field and five (5) years of experience in the job offered or related role. Must have three (3) years of experience with: high-performance Python and Modern C++ development; performance analysis, benchmarking, and profiling on NVIDIA GPUs using Nsight or similar tools; and GPU memory architecture and memory optimization for deep learning workloads. Must have two (2) years of experience with: making open-source pull requests to PyTorch or vLLM; CUDA, Triton, or CUTLASS kernel optimization; LLM inference optimization, including quantization, KV cache or batching; distributed computing including inter and intra GPU communication protocols; and leading technical design, reviewing performance-critical code. #LI-DNI The salary range for this position is $ 186,160 - $287,410 /year. Actual offer will be based on your qualifications. Pay Transparency Red Hat determines compensation based on several factors including but not limited to job location, experience, applicable skills and training, external market value, and internal pay equity. Annual salary is one component of Red Hat’s compensation package. This position may also be eligible for bonus, commission, and/or equity. For positions with Remote-US locations, the actual salary range for the position may differ based on location but will be commensurate with job duties and relevant work experience. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact. jobs.title: Sr. Mgr, GenAI/ML SpecialistSA, GenAI/ML Specialist Solutions Architects
jobs.jd: AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and unwavering support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow. Are you energized to create new markets for GenAI, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning technologies? Do you love scaling new businesses? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is proud to be the pioneer and widely recognized leader in Cloud Computing. Our web services provide IT infrastructure in-the-cloud that is used by hundreds of thousands of developers and businesses around the world. These customers range from start-ups to leading web companies to Global 500 companies in industries such as financial services, pharmaceuticals, and high technology. AWS customers are looking for ways to change their business models and solve complex business challenges with GenAI in the cloud and AWS is leading the way in providing customers with a broad portfolio of GenAI/ML services. AWS is seeking a seasoned Solutions Architect leader to help us scale our GenAI/ML business in Auto/Mfg and Media & Entertainment segments. The AWS machine learning portfolio includes services, such as Quick, Kiro, Bedrock, AgentCore and SageMaker. While the GenAI/ML market is early in its maturity, most all customers are looking for ways to incorporate it into their business to improve customer engagement, optimize operations, manage risk, and glean more insights from their data. The NAMER Specialist Organization is seeking an accomplished Solutions Architect leader deeply familiar with GenAI/ML services, who has overachieved throughout their career and built strong, deep relationships with F1000 and/or G2000 organizations. This leader will partner with Sales and Product teams to build a strategy focused on winning new customers and growing existing customers for the long term. The right candidate must possess top of the line leadership skills with the ability to execute on key business initiatives. This is an exciting opportunity to own the technical strategy definition and execution of AWS’s strategy for GenAI/ML Services in Auto/Mfg and M&E. Your responsibilities will include defining strategic workloads to drive the necessary technical relationships with customers and partners. It will also require technical depth to help the Sales field prioritize GenAIML for their customers. You will build a high-performing team of deeply technical Solution Architects. As the voice of the customer, you'll work closely with product and other GenAI/ML teams to help them evolve the products and address issues, concerns, and requests from customers. To be successful, you will need to analyze and determine key customer insights from business drivers, customer feedback, and operating metrics. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.jd: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Engineer based in Switzerland. We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer to build and deploy production-grade AI systems that address complex challenges across heavy industries, including utilities, manufacturing, logistics, and energy. You will play a key role in developing a next-generation industrial operating system, taking innovative products from concept to production. The role combines agentic AI, multimodal machine learning, industrial data integration, and full-stack engineering. You will work with real-world data from sensors, machines, and operational systems to deliver intelligent solutions that improve efficiency, reliability, and decision-making. This is a high-ownership opportunity in a fast-moving, zero-to-one product environment. You will help establish the foundations of an ambitious platform designed to transform industrial operations. Accountabilities You will design, build, and ship the core AI capabilities of an industrial intelligence platform, connecting advanced models with operational data, enterprise systems, and practical decision-making tools. Develop and deploy agentic AI systems, including orchestration, tool use, state management, and human-in-the-loop workflows. Build agent runtimes and orchestration frameworks supporting specialized agents for vision quality, predictive maintenance, and operations planning. Design context assembly systems using industrial ontologies and memory, including tool dispatch, approval gates, tracing, and cost controls. Develop multimodal data pipelines combining video processing, computer vision, and structured operational data. Implement computer vision capabilities such as object detection, segmentation, and action recognition, using technologies such as YOLO and OpenCV. Process industrial sensor data, including RTSP video, time-series telemetry, vibration, thermal data, and PLC/OPC-UA streams. Build signal-processing and sensor-correlation workflows, including FFT feature extraction and cross-sensor analysis. Design and contribute to industrial ontologies and knowledge graphs representing plants, assets, sensors, work orders, materials, and maintenance histories. Develop memory systems for trace storage, playbooks, asset templates, and reusable failure-pattern libraries. Build operational interfaces such as dashboards, evidence-based alerting workflows, replanning tools, and audit trails. Develop integration connectors for ERP, CMMS, WMS, industrial historians, and PLC systems, ensuring data normalization and consistent schema mapping. Deliver end-to-end solutions spanning data ingestion, model serving, backend services, and frontend interfaces. Ensure production systems meet demanding requirements for reliability, latency, scalability, cost efficiency, and operational usability. Requirements The ideal candidate is an autonomous, hands-on AI engineer with experience taking complex systems from initial development to production, particularly in environments involving physical-world data and industrial operations. At least 3 years of experience building and shipping production AI systems; 5+ years preferred. Proven experience developing agentic AI products and production systems, including orchestration, tool integration, state management, and human oversight. Experience as an early-stage engineer at a venture-backed startup, contributing to products and systems from zero to one. Strong background in AI and machine learning applied to physical-world systems. Experience working with large-scale industrial data, such as video streams, IoT devices, sensor telemetry, vibration, thermal data, or PLC/OPC-UA systems. Hands-on experience building multimodal AI pipelines that combine computer vision with structured operational data. Understanding of data ingestion, normalization, temporal alignment, data quality, and ground-truth challenges in real-world environments. Experience with industrial ontologies, knowledge graphs, or structured context systems based on asset hierarchies and operational processes. Experience integrating AI systems with enterprise and industrial platforms such as ERP, CMMS, WMS, historians, or PLC systems. Strong software engineering skills across backend and frontend development, including Python and TypeScript. Experience with production-oriented technologies such as FastAPI, PostgreSQL, React Native, and OpenCV. A practical understanding of system reliability, failure modes, latency, cost management, and human interaction. Ability to work autonomously, take ownership, and deliver in a fast-paced, high-intensity environment. Strong motivation to solve complex industrial challenges through hands-on engineering and applied AI. Benefits Opportunity to help build a category-defining industrial operating system with the potential to shape manufacturing plants and industrial facilities over the next 10–20 years. Exceptional employee equity package, with an equity pool described as twice the industry standard and an estimated value of more than $200,000 from day one. Opportunity to work alongside an experienced team with backgrounds in enterprise technology, industrial robotics, autonomous driving, and academic research. Exposure to complex, real-world industrial challenges and large volumes of underutilized sensor data. Direct impact on operational efficiency, predictive maintenance, industrial reliability, and decision-making across major industries. jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer - Canada
jobs.jd: Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team. Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. About the role: ProcessOS is a new kind of Camunda product: business processes described in natural language, generated as executable BPMN workflows, and improved autonomously from production data. We’re hiring the first cohort of Forward Deployed Engineers to bring it into production at enterprise customers. You’ll own the deployment journey from first process file to a working, improving system, and hand off a functioning capability to the customer’s team. The code you write and the patterns you discover feed directly back into how ProcessOS is built. This is a rare opportunity to shape a product, a function, and a field practice from day one. You’ll work end‑to‑end across Java services and React interfaces, collaborating closely with a talented global team to measure, improve, and scale performance and fault tolerance in real-world distributed systems. What You’ll Be Doing: Deploy and prove. Own the journey from first process file to production workflow. At 90 days: at least one workflow running, the improvement loop active, and measurable fitness gains the customer can see. At 12 months: 3–5 customers with viable deployments. Drive organizational adoption. Work across technical and business stakeholders to build understanding and trust, turning early deployments into lasting customer capability. Work at depth technically. Configure and run Camunda clusters locally and in cloud environments. Debug integration failures. Build custom agents where platform defaults don’t fit. Write connector logic that gets legacy enterprise systems talking to ProcessOS. Build the playbook. There is no deployment template yet. Document what good looks like as you discover it, and make the next implementation faster. Feed the product. Custom agents you write get contributed back. Integration patterns get codified. Production bugs you find, you often fix. Your field work is a direct input to ProcessOS. Hand off deliberately. Leave customers with a team that can operate independently, is trained on the platform, and acts on improvement results without you. What You Will Bring to the Role Must Haves: Enterprise production experience: you’ve shipped something inside a large organization and stayed to see it operate. You know why governance and resilience matter at scale. Technical depth: You can debug an integration failure, write a custom agent against a legacy API, stand up a Camunda cluster from scratch, and explain generated BPMN to both engineers and business leads.   • Work independently to troubleshoot integration and flight-readiness issues while collaborating cross-functionally with hardware engineering, firmware/software teams, operations, and QC engineering to escalate complex challenges when required.
  • Act as the primary technical authority in customer engagements, translating mission requirements into concrete system architectures and demonstrable solutions built on AuterionOS and Skynode.
  • Participate in flight testing activities to validate platform stability, safety, and mission performance, resolving technical issues often directly in the field during customer trials and demonstrations.
  • Contribute to technical documentation and continuous improvement of engineering processes.
  • Feed customer and market requirements back into product and engineering teams to influence the roadmap of the Auterion stack.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Working proficiency in C/C++ and Python: you can read, debug and patch existing code and write small tools and scripts
  • Comfortable in Linux environments, including the command line, logs, Docker and basic networking (IP, TCP/UDP)

  • Willing to travel and work on-site with customers, including at test ranges and in field environments

jobs.title: AI Engineer l Young Talent Program
jobs.jd: The rules of building are being rewritten. Come write them with us. Every few decades, the way companies are built gets reinvented from scratch. That is happening right now, and the people who learn to build in this new world first will define the next twenty years. Superstars are being made this year, not in ten. HelloPrint is a €100M+ e-commerce company serving businesses across Europe and the US. We are rebuilding the entire company as AI-first: our platform, customer service, operations, and how we design, price, sell, and deliver. Every piece of technology we run is being rewritten as we speak. We are doing it with a small, senior, very fast AI development team working shoulder to shoulder with our business leads. Now we are opening a handful of seats for young builders who want to grow faster than any graduate scheme, bootcamp, or big-tech ladder could ever let them. We don't care if you are 16, 25 or 30, whether you are self-taught, hacking in high school, or finishing a degree at TU Delft or TU/e—we care about what you have built and how fast you solve hard problems. The HelloPrint AI Residency is how you start. It is a permanent role from day one: your first year is a structured residency where you rotate across our most important AI projects, build alongside the team and learn at full speed. After that, you keep growing - in the direction where you have the most impact. What you will actually do: You will not get a training plan, a sandbox project or six months of shadowing. From week one, you build real things that real customers and colleagues use, on the projects that matter most to the company. You sit next to the founders, next to the engineers who are rebuilding our platform, and next to the business leads who own the outcomes. You get a lot of freedom and real responsibility, plus honest, direct guidance and feedback from people who have built this before. The kind of work you could be on in your first months: Agentic Commerce : making HelloPrint discoverable and orderable through AI assistants, so a customer can order business cards from inside a chat. AI Design Studio : letting customers create a print-ready design from a single sentence. AI-first customer service : replacing classic ticketing with agents that resolve questions, check artwork and handle orders end to end. Internal agent swarms : automating finance, purchasing, pricing and operations work that today still takes people hours. Whatever you spot next : if you see something we should build, you pitch it, and if it is good, you build it. We work with almost every modern framework and model, and we change our tools the moment something better appears. You will ship, measure, throw away and ship again - every week. Who you are: You are a builder before anything else . You have shipped things nobody asked you to build: an app, an agent, a bot, a tool your friends actually use, a side business, an open-source contribution, a weird experiment that taught you something. You probably have more GitHub commits, demos or deployed projects than most people twice your age. You are extremely curious and extremely critical. You read the new model release the day it drops and try it that evening. You question every assumption, including ours, and you can explain why. You are never satisfied with "it works" — you want to know why it works, and how it could be ten times better. You want to get better every single day, and you treat feedback as fuel rather than criticism. You take ownership: when something breaks, you fix it; when something is unclear, you go and find out. You have a solid grasp of backend and software fundamentals (Python, APIs, databases) or the raw learning capacity to pick them up in weeks. You will probably recognise yourself in most of this: You build with AI every day: Claude, Cursor, Lovable, agents, APIs, whatever gets you there fastest. You can show us concrete proof of work, not just tell us about it. You move fast without being sloppy, and you care about the details the customer sees. You are comfortable not knowing the answer, and you find it quickly. You communicate clearly in English, in writing and out loud. What we do not require: a degree, a minimum age, years of experience or a perfect CV. If you are still in school or university, we will make it work around that. What you get: The honest pitch: you will learn more here in one year than in five years almost anywhere else , because you will be building real systems for a real company that is reinventing itself, with the people who are leading that change. A contract from day one. The Residency is your first year at HelloPrint, not a trial period or an internship. Direct access to the founders and to a senior AI development team who review your work and push you. Ownership from day one : your name on projects that change how a €100M+ company runs. The best tools, no budget debates : the newest models, coding agents and frameworks, as soon as they are worth using. A growth path that follows your output, not your age : if you outgrow your role in six months, your role grows with you. A fast, flat, no-politics team in Rotterdam, with a hands-on culture and a high bar. Flexible set-up : full-time, or part-time alongside your studies. We care about what you deliver. Salary and contract are tailored to your situation and your level, and we pay properly for real talent. How to apply: Skip the cover letter. Show us what you have built. Send us three things: Your best project : a link to something you built: a live product, a repo, a demo video. Tell us in a few sentences what it does and what you would do differently now. Something you think is broken : one thing about HelloPrint (our website, our ordering flow, anything) that you would rebuild with AI, and how you would do it. A short intro : who you are and what you are obsessed with right now. Five sentences is plenty. What happens next: We read every application ourselves and reply within 5 days

jobs.jd: Robots are about to step out of the movies and into our homes. If you're excited about this robotics revolution, come join Amazon's Fauna Robotics. As an Applied Scientist in this org, you'll push the state-of-the-art techniques in Robotics. You'll drive technical excellence in areas such as perception, manipulation, sim2real transfer, reinforcement learning and multi-task learning, designing novel algorithms that bridge the gap between research and real-world deployment. In this role, you will integrate hands-on technical expertise with scientific leadership, ensuring your team delivers robust solutions for dynamic real-world environments. While staying updated with the latest advancements in robotics research, you will leverage your experience and expertise to guide the team towards the most promising direction. Collaborating with a talented group of software engineers and scientists, you will bring your ideas to fruition. Deploying robots in home environments requires you to anticipate challenges not encountered in structured settings like warehouses. Additionally, consumer-grade sensors and actuators necessitate working around their limitations, requiring out-of-the-box innovative ideas. As such, you are someone who truly enjoys thinking about problems using first principles at a holistic and systems level to address the aforementioned challenges. Key job responsibilities - Lead technical initiatives in areas such as robotics foundation models, reinforcement learning and manipulation - - Design experiments to identify the limitations of current state-of-the-art models and developing new models or techniques that can surpass these models - Design and implement novel deep learning architectures that push the boundaries of what robots can understand and accomplish - Mentor fellow scientists while maintaining strong individual technical contributions - Collaborate with engineering teams to optimize and scale models for real-world applications - Influence technical decisions and implementation strategies within your area of focus - Experienced in communicating complex technical work to a non-technical audience - The ability to work with minimal guidance, be proactive and to handle ambiguity and the challenge of quickly evolving goals About the team Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces. We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products. Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful. At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.jd: About the Role We’re looking for a top-tier Forward Deployed Engineer to join Linkup and work hand-in-hand with our founders, customers, and partners. You'll be part of the founding FDE team at Linkup Your mission: help leading AI companies, developers, and enterprises integrate Linkup’s AI-ready search APIs into their products - and shape how the next generation of AI agents connects to the web. This is a highly cross-functional role. You’ll operate at the intersection of engineering, GTM, and customer success , turning technical integrations into insights that drive our product roadmap, marketing narratives, and outbound strategy. You’ll be the connective bridge between what customers build with Linkup and how we tell that story to the world. What You’ll Do Work directly with customers and partners to design, prototype, and deploy integrations of Linkup’s APIs into real-world agentic systems. Participate in pre-sales efforts - technical discovery, proof-of-concept design, demo environments. Collaborate cross-functionally with backend, ML, and product teams to ensure performance and reliability at scale. Partner with the GTM Engineer and DevRel team to turn customer learnings into automation, tutorials, and playbooks. Identify and implement technical integrations with our other partners in the value chain (workflow orchestration, AI frameworks, etc.) Translate complex technical concepts into clear explanations for both developers and business audiences. Why This Role Matters Every integration you build helps define how AI systems connect to live, trusted information . You’ll operate on the frontier between customers and product - bringing the voice of the field into everything we build and say. Your work will inform: The stories we tell in marketing. The use cases we automate in our GTM systems. The features we prioritize in our roadmap. If you love blending engineering with impact - building things users actually depend on: this role is for you. You’re a Great Fit If You 2+ years in technical support engineering , software engineering , or solutions engineering , with direct application development experience. Strong API integration skills - able to design and debug REST/JSON payloads, manage auth flows, and optimize latency. Understand web infrastructure, distributed systems, or retrieval pipelines. Are comfortable debugging integrations and solving ambiguous technical challenges in customer environments. Communicate clearly and empathetically with both technical and business audiences. Are curious about AI infrastructure, retrieval, and the emerging agentic ecosystem. Thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership startup environment. Example Projects Help a partner integrate Linkup’s /search endpoint into their multi-agent workflow. Build a proof-of-concept combining a customer’s private data with Linkup’s real-time web results. Collaborate with the backend team to improve SDK telemetry and enterprise deployment reliability. Work with the GTM team to turn successful integrations into published use cases and reference architectures. Identify recurring customer needs that can become productized templates or automation. About Linkup Our Vision We believe in a future of AI agents and the agentic web . These digital entities can create more value for humanity than we ever could alone, but they depend on the internet to operate, collaborate, take action, and gather information. AI agents need web search . To perform well, they require information that is current, reliable, and context‑specific—not the diffuse, steadily aging knowledge frozen at their last training cut‑off. Modern web search is built for humans, not AIs . Instead of trusted facts, it serves links, ads, and click‑bait. People want visually engaging pages; AI systems need structured truth. An AI can absorb oceans of data, while human attention barely skims the surface. Humans think visually and intuitively; AI reasons in latent space. Web 2.0 is sunsetting . The deck is being reshuffled, and the Bing‑Google search oligopoly is crumbling. Indexing ever more pages is no longer the goal; semantically organizing facts for AI systems is. In the coming agentic web, Google’s ad‑driven model has no natural home. Search for AI must be rebuilt from the ground up . We are reconstructing the web as a rigorously structured knowledge layer, mapping every concept, entity, and claim into a coherent semantic graph. This foundation delivers verified facts and rich context to AI instantly, unlocking faster reasoning, higher accuracy, and radically more useful answers for everyone. Humans search Google; AI searches Linkup. Our Mission Reality never stands still, and neither should intelligence. Linkup reconnects language models to a living stream of verified facts, ensuring AIs remain as current and insightful as the world they serve. Our mission is to deliver the world’s freshest, most trusted knowledge to AIs. Our Culture Our culture is built on the following values: Mission . We believe we play a critical role in building the agentic web. We are 100% committed to our mission of bringing the reality of the world to AI agents. Speed . We build fast, we build to last. We get things done, well. Ownership . We empower every team member to take ownership of their projects, ensuring they see them through to successful completion. Teamwork . Our strength lies in our unity. We rely on one another and embrace our diversity as a core asset. Humility . We maintain low egos, showing respect for others and continuously learning from their insights and experiences. We expect all team member to take an active role in shaping our company culture. Our Team We are small technical team, working shoulder to shoulder to build the web of agents. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer – SAP (m/f/d)
jobs.location: Berlin, with travel across DACH Germany
jobs.jd: About Qorelo Almost every company running SAP faces the same task: the move to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point. Nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades. That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI platform for S/4HANA transformation. Qorelo reads code, processes, documentation and how the system is actually used, makes the existing landscape transparent, and delivers the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. We take a clean core, target-architecture-first approach and carry it end to end across SAP Activate, from Discover to Realize. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards, long after the system integrators have moved on. We have raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies, including Mercedes-Benz. The role As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you are Qorelo’s technical face at the customer. You run workshops and demos on the customer’s real SAP landscape, get Qorelo connected to their systems and tools, and make sure the platform delivers on their data and their processes. Then you bring what you learned back to our engineers. You work directly with our engineering team and solution architects, report to Marino, our CTO, and spend a real share of your time with customers, both on site and remotely. What you will own SAP connectivity. RFC connections, technical users and authorisations. You make the connection work and explain it to Basis and security teams in their language. Workshops and demos on real environments. You run on-site workshops of several hours and show Qorelo on the customer’s own SAP landscape, not a sandbox: their custom code, their processes, their data. You prepare together with sales and our solution architects, and you handle the technical questions in the room. Integrations. You connect the customer’s tools to Qorelo through our existing integrations across the SAP, Atlassian, Microsoft and similar ecosystems, and make sure they work on the customer’s landscape. The feedback loop. What you see at customers (where the product wins, where it falls short, what they asked for) comes back to engineering and product as clear, concrete feedback. You are the engineering team’s eyes and ears at the customer. What you need 5+ years in technical, customer-facing roles around SAP: technical SAP consultant, solutions or presales engineer, or an engineer who spent much of their time with customers. Solid SAP technical understanding: you know how an SAP landscape fits together (ECC, S/4HANA), what RFC connections, technical users and authorisations are, and what a Basis team will ask you. You do not need to be an ABAP developer. Enough technical depth to set up and troubleshoot a connection with the customer’s IT: credentials, firewalls, proxies, VPN, certificates. Strong presence in the room: you can run a five-hour workshop with consultants, IT leads and process owners, demo live on their system, and keep it on track when something does not work. Real AI curiosity: you use LLM tools yourself and can explain clearly what Qorelo does and where its limits are. Willingness to travel within Europe for on-site demos and workshops. Fluent English. German is a plus for our DACH client base. You might be a fit if You have been the person customers want in the room for the demo, and the one consultants call when the connection does not work. You have worked at an SAP consultancy, system integrator or SAP software vendor and want to be closer to a product. You enjoy a full day of workshops at a customer and can still explain clearly afterwards what worked, what did not and why. You have taken software through an enterprise IT and security onboarding and know why it takes as long as it does. What we offer Real ownership . Meaningful equity and a direct hand in how Qorelo runs in the field. We are looking for people who want to shape a company, not join one. Competitive salary , benchmarked for senior customer-facing technical talent in Berlin. The problems. Fortune 500 and DAX 40 production landscapes, including Mercedes-Benz. You work at the core of SAP systems most engineers never get to touch. The team. Short paths, fast decisions, and a direct line to our CTO, our founding engineer and our solution architects. 25 days paid vacation + German public holidays. Company offsites with the whole team. An office at the Wasserturm in Prenzlauer Berg – where you work when you are not with customers. The fridge is stocked. Wellhub membership , top-tier equipment and access to the latest AI tools. Hiring process Intro call with Gaspar, our founding engineer (30 min) Deep dive on your SAP and customer-facing background with Marino, our CTO (60 min) Practical case: a workshop and live demo simulation with our engineers and solution architects Offer How to apply Send us your CV at Qorelo is an equal opportunity employer. We make our decisions regardless of gender, age, origin, religion, disability or sexual identity. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Applied AI Delivery Lead - NYC
jobs.jd: ABOUT THE ROLE OpenAI’s largest and most strategic customers are turning AI ambition into deployments that change how their organizations work. As a Delivery Lead, you will own delivery of priority AI initiatives for these customers, leading complex, high-impact deployments from planning through launch and adoption. You’ll establish an integrated delivery plan, drive execution against launch commitments, resolve blockers, and lead progress toward measurable customer value. You’ll partner closely with account and technical teams, FDEs, customers, and delivery partners to turn customer priorities into successful deployments. You’ll bring a clear view of delivery progress, risks, and expected outcomes, helping teams make informed decisions and connecting successful execution to consumption and growth. This is a senior, customer-facing role for someone who can move between executive conversations and practical details that determine whether a deployment succeeds. You bring technical fluency, sound judgment, and the ability to create clarity and drive action in complex, evolving environments. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Own delivery of priority AI initiatives. Lead complex customer engagements from scoping and planning through deployment, launch, and initial adoption. - Build and drive an integrated delivery plan. Establish clear scope, milestones, accountable owners, dependencies, resource needs, and success measures across customer, OpenAI, and partner teams. - Resolve blockers and drive decisions. Identify risks early, work through dependencies and resource constraints, and bring the right stakeholders together to resolve tradeoffs and keep delivery moving. - Lead launch readiness and activation. Drive rollout and enablement planning, address technical and organizational readiness gaps, and remove barriers to initial adoption and usage. - Connect delivery to customer value. Define expected outcomes and measurement approaches with customers and account teams. Track adoption and consumption, assess results against agreed baselines, and communicate the value achieved. - Provide a clear view of delivery health. Lead customer and internal delivery reviews that drive decisions and action. Communicate progress, launch confidence, risks, and implications for expected consumption and revenue timing. - Improve how we deliver. Turn customer experience into repeatable playbooks, practical tools, and actionable feedback for product and delivery teams. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - 7+ years of experience leading complex enterprise technology deployments, customer delivery programs, or transformation initiatives involving multiple teams and partners. - A track record of driving programs from scope through launch and adoption, with accountability for delivery commitments and measurable customer outcomes. - Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to understand AI systems, APIs, integrations, enterprise architecture, security dependencies, and deployment risks. - The ability to translate customer priorities into actionable delivery plans with clear milestones, owners, dependencies, and success measures. - Strong judgment under ambiguity, including the ability to identify material risks, navigate competing priorities, and drive timely decisions. - Experience building trust with customers and leading across teams outside your reporting line while holding stakeholders accountable to shared commitments. - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage executives, technical specialists, and customer operators and explain complex delivery issues clearly. - Commercial awareness and an understanding of how deployment, adoption, and consumption contribute to customer value and growth. - A practical approach to building repeatable delivery methods while adapting to the needs of individual About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist, Fauna
jobs.jd: We are seeking an Senior Applied Scientist to lead the development of evaluation frameworks and data collection protocols for robotic capabilities. In this role, you will focus on designing how we measure, stress-test, and improve robot behavior across a wide range of real-world tasks. Your work will play a critical role in shaping how policies are validated and how high-quality datasets are generated to accelerate system performance. You will operate at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and human-in-the-loop systems, building the infrastructure and methodologies that connect teleoperation, evaluation, and learning. This includes developing evaluation policies, defining task structures, and contributing to operator-facing interfaces that enable scalable and reliable data collection. The ideal candidate is highly experimental, systems-oriented, and comfortable working across software, robotics, and data pipelines, with a strong focus on turning ambiguous capability goals into measurable and actionable evaluation systems. Key job responsibilities - Design and implement evaluation frameworks to measure robot capabilities across structured tasks, edge cases, and real-world scenarios - Develop task definitions, success criteria, and benchmarking methodologies that enable consistent and reproducible evaluation of policies - Create and refine data collection protocols that generate high-quality, task-relevant datasets aligned with model development needs - Build and iterate on teleoperation workflows and operator interfaces to support efficient, reliable, and scalable data collection - Analyze evaluation results and collected data to identify performance gaps, failure modes, and opportunities for targeted data collection - Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate evaluation tooling, logging systems, and data pipelines into the broader robotics stack - Stay current with advances in robotics, evaluation methodologies, and human-in-the-loop learning to continuously improve internal approaches - Lead technical projects from conception through production deployment - Mentor junior scientists and engineers About the team Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces. We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products. Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful. At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build. If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you. - PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience - Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language - Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals - Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing - Experience using Unix/Linux - Experience in professional software development Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.title: Applied Scientist , Fauna
jobs.jd: We are seeking an Applied Scientist to develop and optimize Visual Inertial Odometry (VIO) and sensor fusion systems for our intelligent robots. In this role, you will design, implement, and deploy state estimation and tracking algorithms that enable robots to understand their position and motion in real time, even in challenging and dynamic environments. You will own the full pipeline from algorithm development through embedded deployment, ensuring that perception systems run efficiently on resource-constrained robotic hardware. You will also leverage modern machine learning approaches to push the boundaries of classical perception methods, combining learned representations with geometric techniques to achieve robust, real-time performance. This is a deeply hands-on role. You will work directly with sensors, hardware, and real-world data, while prototyping, testing, and iterating in physical environments. The ideal candidate has strong foundations in VIO and sensor fusion, practical experience optimizing algorithms for embedded platforms, and familiarity with how modern deep learning is transforming perception. Key job responsibilities - Design and implement Visual Inertial Odometry algorithms for robust real-time state estimation on robotic platforms like Sprout - Develop multi-sensor fusion pipelines integrating cameras, IMUs, and other sensing modalities for accurate pose tracking - Optimize perception and tracking algorithms for deployment on embedded hardware (e.g., ARM, GPU-accelerated edge devices) under strict latency and power constraints - Apply modern ML-based perception techniques (learned features, depth estimation, neural odometry) to complement and improve classical geometric approaches - Build and maintain calibration, evaluation, and benchmarking infrastructure for perception systems - Collaborate with hardware, controls, and navigation teams to integrate perception outputs into the robot’s autonomy stack - Lead technical projects from research prototyping through production deployment - 3+ years of building models for business application experience - Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals - Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language - Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing - Hands-on experience developing and deploying Visual Inertial Odometry or visual-inertial SLAM systems - Strong understanding of multi-sensor fusion (cameras, IMUs, odometry) and state estimation (EKF, factor graphs) - Experience optimizing perception algorithms for embedded or resource-constrained hardware - Demonstrated hands-on experience with real sensor data, calibration, and physical robot platforms - Familiarity with modern ML approaches to perception (learned feature extraction, depth prediction, end-to-end odometry) - Experience using Unix/Linux - Experience in professional software development - Publication record at major robotics or computer vision conferences (e.g., ICRA, IROS, RSS, CVPR, ECCV) - Experience with real-time systems programming and performance profiling on ARM/GPU platforms - Experience with state estimation on legged robots - Experience with stereo vision systems, camera-IMU calibration, time synchronization, and sensor characterization - Track record of shipping VIO or SLAM systems to production on physical robots at scale - Experience with NVIDIA Jetson, Qualcomm RB5, or similar embedded AI platforms - Familiarity with ROS/ROS2 - Experience integrating learned perception modules (e.g., neural depth, feature matching networks) into geometric estimation pipelines -
